html:
Join us for a relaxing sunset and night squid fishing experience in Phu Quoc. The tour starts at Duong Dong Harbor, located in the center of Duong Dong Ward near the famous Dinh Cau Lighthouse.

From the boat, enjoy a spectacular panoramic sunset view over the sea and coastline. As the sun sets, the boat moves to a suitable fishing area where guests will learn how to use traditional local fishing equipment and experience night-time squid fishing.

Any squid caught can be freshly prepared and cooked by our friendly crew. Enjoy a light dinner onboard while the boat slowly cruises back to the harbor, surrounded by the calm and peaceful night sea.

After the tour, guests may choose to return to their hotel or explore the lively nightlife of Duong Dong Ward on their own.

ITINERARY

16:45 – 17:00

Pick-up at hotels in Duong Dong Ward.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are kindly requested to contact us in advance.

Depart from Duong Dong Harbor.

Enjoy the beautiful sunset onboard.

Take time to admire the panoramic sunset scenery as the boat sails smoothly across the sea. The fresh ocean breeze helps you relax and forget daily stress.

Night squid fishing experience.

The boat will stop at a fishing area. Our tour guide will introduce traditional fishing equipment and demonstrate simple techniques for catching squid.

Freshly cooked squid.

Our crew will happily prepare and cook any squid you catch.

Light dinner onboard.

Relax, enjoy your meal, and take in the peaceful atmosphere as the boat slowly returns to the harbor.

21:00

Return to your hotel.

TOUR PRICE

  • Adults (from 10 years old): 10 United States dollars per person

  • Children (from 5 to 9 years old): 5 United States dollars per child

  • Children under 5 years old: Free of charge

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Round-trip transportation by car and boat

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • One bottle of drinking water per guest

  • Light dinner onboard

  • Traditional local fishing equipment

  • Life jackets

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Personal expenses not mentioned in the inclusions

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • The itinerary may be adjusted depending on weather conditions.

  • During the rainy season, from May to November, the boat may depart from Sao Beach or An Thoi. In this case, the sunset view will not be available.

DINNER MENU

  • Barbecue shrimp

  • Stir-fried noodles with vegetables

  • Squid porridge

  • Fresh seasonal fruit

Special meal requests such as vegan, vegetarian, or children’s meals must be informed at the time of booking or at least twenty-four hours before departure.

CHILDREN’S PRICING POLICY

  • Children aged ten years and above are charged the adult price.

  • Children aged from five to nine years are charged fifty percent of the adult price.

  • Children under five years old are free of charge.

Age is determined by year of birth.

PAYMENT POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date or on the tour day.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date.

CANCELLATION POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • Cancellation two days before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: fifty percent of the tour value will be charged.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

Weather-related cancellations for sea tours:

  • If the Port Authority does not allow the boat to depart, Vietlook Travel will cancel the tour and provide a full refund.

  • If the Port Authority allows the tour to operate and guests choose to cancel, no refund will be provided.

TIPS FOR GUESTS

What to Bring

  • Towel

  • Environmentally friendly sunscreen

  • Change of clothes and swimwear

  • Comfortable shoes or flip-flops

  • Personal necessities

  • Essential items for children, if traveling with kids

Vietlook Travel and its staff are not responsible for any lost, misplaced, or stolen items.

Environmental Responsibility

  • Do not throw any objects or trash into the sea. Trash bins are provided onboard.

  • Do not leave trash on islands. Please use designated recycling bins.

HEALTH AND SAFETY NOTICE

  • This tour is not recommended for guests with limited mobility, wheelchair users, or those with medical conditions such as asthma, heart problems, seizures, panic attacks, lung or ear conditions, severe allergies, or epilepsy.

  • Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult a doctor before joining the tour.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible or liable for any health-related issues that may occur during the tour.
outline: Day 1: SUNSET AND NIGHT SQUID FISHING TOUR
